messages:
tom: deploy-bot reports OOM spike on dedicated pool eu-west-1 after rollout to v4.0.0. Autorollback scheduled in 7m. tagging ops for hold/veto. logs: https://internal.redwood/logs/3090011222

deploy-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated eu-west-1 OOMs increased from 0.02% -> 1.8%. Suggested action: ROLLBACK -> v3.9.8 for dedicated. Auto-rollback in 7m unless operator override. Possible cause: new memory allocator flag.

rina: looks like sessions with long-context chat are hitting OOMs. can we limit to dedicated pools only? prefer targeted rollback, not global.

ops-oncall: oncall here. request 5m hold to run quick memory traces and verify impact. avoid immediate autorollback to prevent churn.

tom: holding 5m. plan: run heap-snapshot probe at +1m, review traces at +3m, then decide. kate please prep comms if we rollback.

productops: noted. hold public release blurb until we confirm. we'll need a short internal blurb if rollback occurs.

kate: prepping template: "We performed a targeted rollback for customers on eu-west-1 dedicated pools due to increased OOMs. No impact to hosted API customers." Will wait for final confirmation.

ops-oncall: probe results: heap snapshots show allocator surge on model shards with kv cache enabled. error grouping indicates allocator flag regression. still ongoing. recommending manual partial rollback for dedicated pools now.

rina: steps to execute: 1) `infra pin-pool --region eu-west-1 --pool dedicated --version 3.9.8` 2) `infra drain --pool dedicated --timeout 45s` 3) `infra rollback-exec --pool dedicated --to 3.9.8` 4) `monitor p95,OOMs,errors 10m`

tom: executing step1+2 now.

ops-oncall: rollback complete for dedicated eu-west-1. post-rollback metrics: OOM rate back to 0.03%, p95 stable. autorollback canceled by operator.

kate: internal note posted to #status-internal. holding customer-facing note per productops. filing follow-up ticket INF-4900: investigate allocator flag regression.

tom: closing thread: manual targeted rollback executed, autorollback canceled, release notes freeze until postmortem. thanks all.
